```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r instalar, eval=FALSE}
BiocManager::install("TENxBrainData")
```

```{r libraries}
library(TENxBrainData)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(igraph)
```

```{r cargar_referencia}
stopifnot(file.exists("../output/brain_referencia.RData"))
load("../output/brain_referencia.RData")
```

```{r preparar_datos}
# Descargar datos y seleccionar 3000 células
sce <- TENxBrainData20k()
set.seed(42)
sce <- sce[, sample(ncol(sce), 3000)]

# Asignar símbolos génicos; usar Ensembl cuando falte el símbolo
simbolos <- as.character(rowData(sce)$Symbol)
ensembl <- as.character(rowData(sce)$Ensembl)
simbolos[is.na(simbolos) | simbolos == ""] <-
  ensembl[is.na(simbolos) | simbolos == ""]
rownames(sce) <- make.unique(simbolos)

# Asignar identificadores celulares únicos
colnames(sce) <- make.unique(
  paste(colData(sce)$Library, colData(sce)$Barcode, sep = "_")
)

# Extraer matriz de UMI y crear objeto Seurat
counts <- as(assay(sce, "counts"), "dgCMatrix")
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "Brain_E18")

obj
```

```{r explorar_datos}
cat("Células:", ncol(obj), "\nGenes:", nrow(obj), "\n")
head(rownames(obj))
head(colnames(obj))
assayNames(sce)
as.matrix(counts[1:5, 1:5])
```

```{r calcular_qc}
genes_mt <- grep("^mt-", rownames(obj), value = TRUE)
genes_mt

obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, features = genes_mt)
metricas_qc <- c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt")
summary(obj[[]][, metricas_qc])
```

```{r violin_antes, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
VlnPlot(obj, features = metricas_qc, layer = "counts", ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
```

```{r scatter_antes, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") + NoLegend()
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") + NoLegend()
plot1 + plot2
```

```{r filtrar_qc}
antes <- c(Celulas = ncol(obj), Genes = nrow(obj),
           Genes_detectados = sum(Matrix::rowSums(counts) > 0))
obj <- subset(obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > 300 & nFeature_RNA < 5000 & percent.mt < 10)
despues <- c(Celulas = ncol(obj), Genes = nrow(obj),
             Genes_detectados = sum(Matrix::rowSums(GetAssayData(obj, layer = "counts")) > 0))
data.frame(Antes = antes, Despues = despues, Eliminados = antes - despues,
           Perdida_pct = round(100 * (antes - despues) / antes, 2))
summary(obj[[]][, metricas_qc])
```

```{r violin_despues, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
VlnPlot(obj, features = metricas_qc, layer = "counts", ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
```

```{r scatter_despues, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") + NoLegend()
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") + NoLegend()
plot1 + plot2
```

```{r sin_normalizacion, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
stopifnot(identical(colnames(obj), colnames(referencia$counts)))
LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data") <- GetAssayData(obj, layer = "counts")
celdas <- head(colnames(obj), 100)
crudos <- GetAssayData(obj, layer = "data")[, celdas]
normalizados <- referencia$normalizados[, celdas]
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(log1p(crudos@x), breaks = 50, col = "grey70", main = "Sin normalizar: log1p solo al graficar", xlab = "Expresión")
hist(normalizados@x, breaks = 50, col = "steelblue", main = "Referencia: LogNormalize", xlab = "Expresión")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r genes_variables, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(VariableFeatures(obj), referencia$variables))
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(obj), 10)
top10
LabelPoints(plot = VariableFeaturePlot(obj), points = top10, repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()
```

```{r calcular_pca}
obj <- ScaleData(obj, 
                 features = VariableFeatures(obj), 
                 verbose = FALSE)
obj <- RunPCA(obj, 
              features = VariableFeatures(obj), 
              npcs = 2000, approx = FALSE, 
              verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r elbow_pca, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
ElbowPlot(obj, ndims = 30)
```

```{r scree_pca, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
var_pct <- 100 * Stdev(obj, reduction = "pca")^2 / sum(Stdev(obj, reduction = "pca")^2)
plot(1:30, var_pct[1:30], type = "b", pch = 16,
     xlab = "PC", ylab = "Varianza explicada (%)", main = "Scree plot: PC 1 a 30")
```

```{r varianza_acumulada}
porcentaje <- 30 # Porcentaje de varianza que buscamos explicar
var_acumulada <- cumsum(var_pct)
n_pc <- which(var_acumulada >= porcentaje)[1]
cat("Para explicar al menos", porcentaje, "% de la varianza se necesitan", n_pc, "PC.\n")
```

```{r pesos_pca, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
VizDimLoadings(obj, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
```

```{r clustering}
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.5, random.seed = 42, verbose = FALSE)
head(Idents(obj), 5)
nlevels(Idents(obj)) # Número de clusters
```

```{r tamano_clusters, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
tamano_clusters <- table(Idents(obj))
tamano_clusters
round(100 * prop.table(tamano_clusters), 1) # Porcentaje por cluster
barplot(tamano_clusters, col = "steelblue", 
        xlab = "Cluster", ylab = "Células")
```

```{r comparar_umap, fig.width=21, fig.height=7}
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:20, n.neighbors = 30, min.dist = 0.3, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:20, n.neighbors = 50, min.dist = 0.5, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE, reduction.name = "umap50")
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:20, n.neighbors = 10, min.dist = 0.1, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE, reduction.name = "umap10")
plot1 <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Vecinos = 30; min.dist = 0.3") + NoLegend()
plot2 <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap50", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Vecinos = 50; min.dist = 0.5") + NoLegend()
plot3 <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap10", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Vecinos = 10; min.dist = 0.1") + NoLegend()
plot1 + plot2 + plot3
```

```{r comparar_tsne, fig.width=15, fig.height=4}
obj <- RunTSNE(obj, dims = 1:20, perplexity = 30, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)
obj <- RunTSNE(obj, dims = 1:20, perplexity = 50, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE, reduction.name = "tsne50")
obj <- RunTSNE(obj, dims = 1:20, perplexity = 10, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE, reduction.name = "tsne10")
plot1 <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Perplexity = 30") + NoLegend()
plot2 <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne50", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Perplexity = 50") + NoLegend()
plot3 <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne10", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Perplexity = 10") + NoLegend()
plot1 + plot2 + plot3
```

```{r comparar_proyecciones, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
plot1 <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("t-SNE") + NoLegend()
plot2 <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("UMAP") + NoLegend()
plot1 + plot2
```

```{r comparar_qc, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
plot1 <- FeaturePlot(obj, features = metricas_qc, 
                     reduction = "tsne", ncol = 1)
plot2 <- FeaturePlot(obj, features = metricas_qc, 
                     reduction = "umap", ncol = 1)
plot1 | plot2
```

```{r}
VlnPlot(obj, features = metricas_qc, layer = "counts", ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
```

```{r comparar_clusters}
clusters_ref <- referencia$cluster[colnames(obj)]
table(Con_normalizacion = clusters_ref, Sin_normalizacion = Idents(obj))
cat("ARI:", igraph::compare(as.integer(clusters_ref), as.integer(Idents(obj)), method = "adjusted.rand"), "\n")
```

```{r grilla_normalizacion, fig.width=13, fig.height=14}
tamano_ref <- as.data.frame(table(clusters_ref))
tamano_raw <- as.data.frame(table(Idents(obj)))
colnames(tamano_ref) <- colnames(tamano_raw) <- c("cluster", "celulas")
p1 <- ggplot(tamano_ref, aes(cluster, celulas)) + geom_col(fill = "steelblue") + ggtitle("Clusters: con normalización")
p2 <- ggplot(tamano_raw, aes(cluster, celulas)) + geom_col(fill = "tomato") + ggtitle("Clusters: sin normalización")
datos_umap <- setNames(data.frame(referencia$umap, cluster = referencia$cluster), c("x", "y", "cluster"))
datos_tsne <- setNames(data.frame(referencia$tsne, cluster = referencia$cluster), c("x", "y", "cluster"))
p3 <- ggplot(datos_umap, aes(x, y, color = cluster)) + geom_point(size = 0.2) + ggtitle("UMAP: con normalización") + theme_classic() + NoLegend()
p4 <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("UMAP: sin normalización") + NoLegend()
p5 <- ggplot(datos_tsne, aes(x, y, color = cluster)) + geom_point(size = 0.2) + ggtitle("t-SNE: con normalización") + theme_classic() + NoLegend()
p6 <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "tsne", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("t-SNE: sin normalización") + NoLegend()
grilla <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) / (p5 + p6)
grilla
```

```{r guardar_sin_normalizar}
dir.create("../output/opcional1", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save(obj, file = "../output/opcional1/brain_sin_normalizar.RData", compress = "xz")
ggsave("../output/opcional1/comparacion_normalizacion.png", grilla, width = 13, height = 14, dpi = 150)
```
